newsitem.title: USA: Exxon says Baton Rouge units down for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Exxon says Baton Rouge units down for maintenance.

text.p: Exxon Corp confirmed Thursday that two units at its giant Baton Rouge, Louisiana refinery were down for scheduled maintenance.

The number-seven pipestill unit with crude distillation of 73,000 barrels per day (bpd) came down on January 10, and the number-two reforming unit with 68,000 bpd capacity came down on January 11, according to an official at Exxon USA, the unit which operates domestic refineries.

The plant has capacity to process 424,000 bpd of crude oil, with total distillation capacity of 193,000 bpd. The reformer upgrades naphtha to lighter products and is the only unit of its sort at the plant.
Exxon's policy is not to comment on future maintenance plans for its plants but to confirm when units go into turnaround, the spokesman said.
